files.name: motion-prompt-228.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Radar chart" (レーダーチャート), one of the names in "Diagrams and charts for slides".
Motion Prompt #228

What it is: A spider web that compares several items
What the sample shows: On a six-axis spider web, a gray polygon spreads out from the center, then a blue one spreads with a slight overshoot.
Spec:
- Scale: four nested hexagons up to radius 86 px (the outer one darker) and six spokes; they stay for the whole cycle
- Comparison: a gray polygon (values 0.46–0.74, fill opacity 0.22) spreads out from the center from 0.4 s to 1.1 s (ease-out)
- Main: a blue polygon (values 0.92, 0.58, 0.84, 0.4, 0.76, 0.52; fill opacity 0.28, 3 px outline, dots on the corners) spreads from 0.95 s to 1.85 s, a 55:45 blend of ease-out and ease-out-back for a slight overshoot
- End: the axes and grid stay; only the data fades out from 4.15 s to 4.55 s (one pass = 4.7 s)
When to use it: To compare the balance of several items, or the strengths and weaknesses of two things.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/228.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/diagram.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
